post.description:
Preview creative assets before permanently uploading them. The endpoint validates
files and metadata and returns the submission shape that `/creative_upload` would
process, without creating creatives.

Creative upload limits:

| Creative upload shape | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Plain/non-ZIP uploaded files | 500KB per uploaded file |
| Uploaded ZIP package | 10MB per ZIP file |
| Direct files in the uploaded outer ZIP | 500KB per direct file |
| Assets inside an inner HTML5 package ZIP | 500KB recommended maximum; warning only |
| Uploaded filename form parts | 10 files max |

Send all files in a request with either the `filename` multipart field name
or the legacy `filename[]` multipart field name; do not mix both field names
in the same request. The OpenAPI
`x-max-file-size: 10485760` value is the transport/schema ceiling for uploaded
ZIP parts. Non-ZIP 500KB and direct outer-ZIP file 500KB limits are endpoint
validation rules. Assets inside an inner HTML5 package ZIP over 500KB are
accepted with a `meta.warnings` entry unless the `html5-file-too-large` sub_code
is promoted to an error by configuration. If multiple ZIP files are uploaded,
ZIP structural/content validation preserves the legacy behavior of validating
the first ZIP selected by the request.

Top-level uploads may use image extensions (`.gif`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`,
`.tiff`, `.tif`, `.svg`), the legacy `.swf` extension, loose HTML/CSS/JS/font
extensions (`.html`, `.htm`, `.css`, `.js`, `.woff`, `.woff2`, `.ttf`, `.otf`),
or ZIP packages. ZIP-inner HTML5 assets may use image extensions plus `.html`,
`.htm`, `.css`, `.js`, `.woff`, `.woff2`, `.ttf`, `.otf`, `.mp4`, and `.webm`.

HTML5 packages must use a two-level ZIP structure: the outer ZIP contains one
or more inner ZIP files, each inner ZIP contains the HTML5 creative assets, and
backup images are included in the outer ZIP. Loose files must not be uploaded
alongside an HTML5 ZIP package. Nested ZIPs beyond two levels are rejected.

HTML5 validation errors and warnings use these stable `sub_code` values:

| `sub_code` | Default disposition | Scope | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `html5-missing-click-tracker` | Error | Inner package | No HTML/JS file contains a MediaMath click-tracker macro |
| `html5-noscript-tag` | Warning | Inner package | Root HTML contains a `<noscript>` tag |
| `html5-storage-api` | Warning | Inner package | HTML/JS file uses `localStorage` or `sessionStorage` |
| `html5-external-reference` | Warning | Inner package | Root HTML references an external asset |
| `html5-invalid-filename-chars` | Warning | Inner package | File name contains spaces, non-ASCII, or other non-standard characters |
| `html5-missing-file-extension` | Warning | Inner package | Extensionless file is recognized by content signature or root HTML reference |
| `html5-unsafe-filename-path` | Error | Inner package | File path is absolute, contains `.`/`..`, drive-letter, or UNC path components |
| `html5-filename-too-long` | Error | Inner package | File path exceeds 255 characters |
| `html5-unsupported-file-type` | Error | Outer ZIP and inner package | File extension is not allowed |
| `html5-file-too-large` | Warning | Inner package | Inner package asset exceeds the recommended 500KB maximum |
| `html5-file-too-large` | Error | Outer ZIP direct entry | Direct entry in uploaded outer ZIP exceeds 500KB |
| `html5-file-read-error` | Error | Inner package | Extracted HTML/JS file cannot be read |
| `html5-backup-mismatch` | Warning | HTML5 package auto-discovery | Backup image matches the package name only by letter case |
| `html5-backup-mismatch` | Error | HTML5 package auto-discovery | No backup metadata and no matching backup image exists |
| `html5-backup-mismatch` | Error | HTML5 package manual backup | Specified backup file is absent from the ZIP |
| `html5-invalid-package-structure` | Error | Outer ZIP | HTML appears directly in the outer ZIP |
| `html5-nested-zip-too-deep` | Error | Outer ZIP | ZIP nesting exceeds two levels |
| `html5-separate-files` | Error | Multipart request | Loose files are uploaded alongside an HTML5 ZIP package |
| `html5-submission-name-mismatch` | Error | Outer ZIP (HTML5) | Inner ZIP name is missing from `metadata.submissions[].name` |
| `submission-name-mismatch` | Error | Outer ZIP (non-HTML5) | Plain ZIP file is missing from `metadata.submissions[].name` |
| `zip-too-large` | Error | Uploaded ZIP | Uploaded ZIP exceeds 10MB |

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of audience segment taxonomies. By default each item
contains only the root node of its taxonomy (`taxonomy.children` is an empty
array); pass `full=true` (or `full=1` / `full=*`) to also return the complete
nested segment tree under each root. Results can be filtered with `q=` and
sorted with `sort_by=`.

**Filterable / sortable fields:**
| Field | Source table |
|---|---|
| `id` | audience_segments |
| `taxonomy_id` | audience_segments |
| `audience_vendor_id` | audience_segments |
| `name` | audience_segments |
| `code` | audience_segments |
| `buyable` | audience_segments |
| `retail_cpm` | audience_segments |
| `wholesale_cpm` | audience_segments |
| `uniques` | audience_segments |
| `visibility` | audience_taxonomies |

Pagination is at the **taxonomy** level: `page_limit=1` returns one taxonomy
(with its complete tree when `full` is set, potentially many segments).
Filtering on segment fields (for example `q=name=:*X*`) still selects taxonomies
that contain a matching segment, regardless of `full`.

deals.description:
Per-deal configuration consistency checks for the PMP deals the strategy
targets (resolved from both direct deals and deal groups). Individual deal
results are informational; `summary` carries the strategy-level rollup, which
is driven by the supply-path logic: when open auction is enabled, deal issues
are downgraded to warnings because an alternative supply path exists; for a
deal-only strategy the summary fails when no deal is fully healthy.

summary.description:
Strategy-level rollup. `pass` when all targeted deals are healthy (or when
no deals are targeted — not applicable); `warning` when some deals have
issues but a viable supply path remains; `fail` for a deal-only strategy
with no viable deal. A warning-level FreeWheel creative approval status
(pending / not submitted / partially rejected) counts as an issue but keeps
the deal viable; a FreeWheel PG deal with every assigned creative rejected
is not viable. Also `warning` when deal data is unavailable.

items.description: One entry per targeted deal. Empty when no deals are targeted or deal data is unavailable.

deal_identifier.description: The deal's external deal identifier; empty string when not configured.

floor_vs_bid_check.description: Compares strategy max bid against the deal floor price; the message includes both values.

creative_format_check.description:
Whether at least one assigned creative matches the deal's required
format/channel (pass when the deal specifies no format). Channels map to
the creative formats that can serve them: Display → display; Video → video;
Audio → audio; CTV → video; DOOH, Mobile Web and Mobile In-app → display or
video. Warns with "no creatives assigned" when the strategy has no assigned
creatives to match.

creative_approval_check.description:
FreeWheel creative approval readiness for this deal. FreeWheel gates delivery
on per-creative approval for PG deals only (never open auction or standard
PMP), so every non-FreeWheel or non-PG deal passes with "not required". For a
FreeWheel PG deal, the strategy's assigned creatives are bucketed by their
latest FreeWheel approval status: `fail` when every assigned creative is
rejected (confirmed block), `warning` when some are rejected or none are
approved yet (pending / not submitted), `pass` when at least one creative is
approved and none are rejected.

creative_approval_readiness.description:
Strategy-context creative approval readiness. Cross-references each
assigned non-native creative's latest per-exchange approval status against the
approval-gated exchanges the strategy targets (Google AdX, Xandr). Native creatives
are excluded from the cross-reference and all counts — they are never submitted for
approval on these exchanges (ES-9095). Individual exchange results are
informational; `summary` carries the rollup. A creative can still serve on an exchange
unless it is rejected there — pending, pending > 48h and not-submitted are non-blocking.
A would-be blocker is downgraded to a warning when any alternative serving path remains
(another approval-gated exchange that can still serve, a targeted RTB-enabled non-approval
exchange that can accept open-auction bids, or run_on_all_exchanges).

summary.description:
Strategy-level rollup. `pass` when at least one approved creative exists on every
targeted approval-gated exchange (or none are targeted — not applicable — or every
assigned creative is native and so requires no exchange approval). `warning`
when the eligible creative pool is reduced but a viable serving path remains, or
creatives are only pending. `fail` when every targeted approval-gated exchange has
all assigned non-native creatives rejected and no alternative supply path exists.

- `<=` - less than or equal to,
- `>` - greater than,
- `>=` - greater than or equal to.

taxonomy_upload_report.description:
CSV impact report. The same format is returned by both the dry-run and apply
endpoints. Response headers carry the numeric counts; the body is a CSV
attachment with two summary blocks followed by an optional affected-strategies
table.

X-Num-Targeting-Segments-Before.description: Number of active targeting segments before this upload.

X-Num-Targeting-Segments-After.description: Number of active targeting segments after this upload.

X-Num-Retired-Targeting-Segments-Before.description: Number of retired targeting segments before this upload.

X-Num-Retired-Targeting-Segments-After.description: Number of retired targeting segments after this upload.

X-Num-Strategy-Targeting-Segments-Before.description: Number of strategy-targeting-segment links before this upload.

X-Num-Strategy-Targeting-Segments-After.description: Number of strategy-targeting-segment links after this upload.

X-Num-Retired-Strategy-Targeting-Segment.description: Number of retired strategy-targeting-segment links before this upload.
Number of retired strategy-targeting-segment links after this upload.

X-Num-Segments-Updated.description: Number of existing segments whose fields would be/were updated.

X-Num-Segments-Added.description: Number of new segments that would be/were inserted.

X-Num-Segments-Removed.description: Number of segments that would be/were retired.

X-Num-Strategies-Migrated.description: Number of distinct strategies that target at least one segment present in the uploaded taxonomy (i.e. segments being kept or updated).

X-Num-Strategies-Targeting-Retired-Segme.description: Number of distinct strategies that were targeting at least one segment being retired.

schema.description:
CRLF-terminated CSV with three sections separated by blank lines:

1. **Header message** — one of:
   - `THE SYSTEM HAS NOT BEEN CHANGED, BUT THIS WOULD BE THE RESULT!` (dry-run)
   - `THE FOLLOWING CHANGES HAVE BEEN APPLIED!` (apply)

2. **Count summary** — two-column rows, key and value:
   ```
   X-Num-Targeting-Segments-Before,<n>
   X-Num-Targeting-Segments-After,<n>
   X-Num-Strategy-Targeting-Segments-Before,<n>
   X-Num-Strategy-Targeting-Segments-After,<n>
   X-Num-Retired-Targeting-Segments-Before,<n>
   X-Num-Retired-Targeting-Segments-After,<n>
   X-Num-Retired-Strategy-Targeting-Segments-Before,<n>
   X-Num-Retired-Strategy-Targeting-Segments-After,<n>
   ```

3. **Diff summary** — two-column rows, key and value:
   ```
   X-Num-Segments-Updated,<n>
   X-Num-Segments-Added,<n>
   X-Num-Segments-Removed,<n>
   X-Num-Strategies-Migrated,<n>
   X-Num-Strategies-Targeting-Retired-Segments,<n>
   ```

4. **Affected strategies table** (only present when at least one strategy targets a segment being retired) —
   header row followed by one data row per affected strategy/segment pair:
   ```
   organization_name,agency_name,advertiser_name,campaign_name,strategy_name,
   strategy_id,strategy_status,strategy_start_date,strategy_end_date,
   targeting_segment_full_path,targeting_segment_external_code
   ```
